name: DC Box
summary: Sold the DC Box Linux router appliance for direct Telstra Wholesale connections (not a conventional ISP); defunct ~2007.

events.details: DC Box Pty Ltd, Ashwood Melbourne.

DC Box appliance site captured 2000-05; by 2006-07 dcbox.com.au showed "Digivation" (engineering/computing consulting at the same Ashwood address) promoting a "DC Server" product; DC Box brand ended c.2006-07.
